title: NorthPeak Store Operations
description: An early cold snap ~3 weeks ago left the same 5 cold-weather apparel SKUs SOLD OUT in ~30 northern stores (~$4.8M lost-sales exposure) and piling as DEAD STOCK in ~40 southern stores (~$5.6M markdown risk). Ask the suggested questions in order to investigate the split, drill into Store 214, and explore recovery moves (transfer / expedite / substitute).
